title: Model Paper 3
html:
MODEL PAPER 3 — MECEE-BL (Group I). Time: 3 hours. Full marks: 200. Attempt all questions. Each question has four options with one best answer; choose the best and mark it on your answer grid.

Each correct answer carries 1 mark and each wrong answer deducts 0.25 mark. Calculators are not allowed; do rough work in the margins. Sit this paper in one uninterrupted sitting, exactly as on the day.

How to score yourself: score = (number correct) − 0.25 × (number wrong). Do not leave blanks — in this marking scheme even a blind guess is worth +1/16 of a mark. Record your correct/wrong/blank counts per subject before you open the key.

This paper follows the official unit weightage exactly:

Answer key and explanations

Answers — Zoology (1–40)

1. (a) — de Vries proposed that new species arise by sudden mutations.

2. (d) — Insect and bird wings do the same job from different origins: convergence.

3. (d) — Chance changes in gene frequencies matter most in small populations.

4. (b) — Sponges pump water through a canal system for filter feeding.

5. (a) — Flatworms such as Planaria excrete through flame cells.

6. (d) — Arthropoda is by far the most species-rich phylum.

7. (c) — The ostrich is a flightless running bird.

8. (c) — Areolar tissue is the general loose packing connective tissue.

9. (d) — Haversian canals organise compact mammalian bone.
